description: This file declares the Http2FrameDecoder class responsible for decoding HTTP/2 frames, including handling frame headers, payloads, and errors. It references various payload decoders and manages decoding state and listener callbacks.

classes.name: Http2FrameDecoder
classes.description: Class responsible for decoding HTTP/2 frames, managing decoding state, payload processing, and error handling.

methods.name: DecodeFrame
methods.description: Decodes the next HTTP/2 frame from the provided buffer, returning status codes indicating progress, completion, or errors.

methods.name: set_listener
methods.description: Sets the listener that will receive callbacks during frame decoding.

methods.name: set_maximum_payload_size
methods.description: Sets the maximum allowed payload size for frames.

methods.name: remaining_payload
methods.description: Returns the number of payload bytes remaining to be decoded.

methods.name: remaining_padding
methods.description: Returns the number of padding bytes remaining to be decoded.
